hooks.command: command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv tool install --quiet --python 3.12 "${AGENT_MEMORY_PACKAGE:-agent-memory-runtime[embedded] @ git+https://github.com/chriswu727/agent-memory}" >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from agent-memory-runtime agent-memory plugin start >/dev/null 2>&1; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from agent-memory-runtime agent-memory plugin hook session-start 2>/dev/null; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from agent-memory-runtime agent-memory plugin hook user-prompt 2>/dev/null; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from agent-memory-runtime agent-memory plugin hook stop 2>/dev/null; true
